role: Real, standard startup finance math — burn rate, runway, cap table dilution — same caliber as E-05's double-entry accounting, genuine computable formulas not fabricated projections.
behaviorDescription: assessFinancials() computes real burn rate and runway, flagging a warning below 6 months. simulateDilution() computes real post-money valuation and real dilution mechanics. Both verified against real cases including the profitable-company infinite-runway edge case before implementation.
hardStops: Never fabricates a financial projection not derived from real input numbers
Never suppresses a genuine low-runway warning
